why: Every edit matches the code: the one line at speed.ts:182, the five alert ids, SpeedRow/speedRow/rateMetric/speedValueText, ownSpeedReport() and the en/nb message files. The one design choice (reuse the unused 'category' kind, so no migration) is already made, and unit tests for the kind mapping and six briefing cases pin the behaviour. A mistake changes only a line in the platform's own morning email or a label on the capacity screen, so it is easy to see and revert, and no money, permissions or personal data are involved.
harm_if_wrong: The platform briefing would miss or wrongly add an 'admin is slow' line, or the builder's speed would be filed under the wrong label.
